capsules.instruction: These are reported prior local results, not cloud rerun evidence. Use accessible published contracts or record the source gap; no credentials or provider calls.

excludedMaterials: credentials, access/refresh tokens, cookies and browser sessions
account/member/store operational bindings and private inventories
raw database bodies, private row hashes and runtime configuration
provider transaction payloads and broad logs
finishCondition: Three finite waves completed; reviewed source, test/build receipts, scoped roadmap delta and all-stream handover produced; publish only after explicit branch permission; then stop.
